title: Challenge 7 Quiz - Trading Systems, Journaling & Performance Evaluation
description: Test your understanding of building trading systems, maintaining professional journals, measuring trading performance and continuously improving your trading process.

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of a trading system?
options: To provide a complete set of rules for making trading decisions
questions.explanation: A trading system provides structured, rule-based decision making rather than guaranteeing profits.

questions.question: Which of the following should be included in a professional trading journal?
options: Every trade including the reasons, emotions and lessons learned
questions.explanation: Professional journals record every trade and the reasoning behind it.

questions.question: According to this course, traders should generally aim for what average risk-to-reward ratio?
questions.explanation: The course recommends seeking an average risk-to-reward ratio of approximately 1:3 whenever market conditions support it.

questions.question: What is the maximum total trading session risk recommended in this course?
questions.explanation: A trader should never exceed a total trading session risk of 5% of trading capital.

questions.question: Which metric measures how often trades are successful?
questions.explanation: Win rate measures the percentage of trades that are profitable.

questions.question: Why should traders review both winning and losing trades?
options: Both winning and losing trades provide opportunities to improve
questions.explanation: Both profitable and losing trades can reveal strengths, weaknesses and areas for improvement.

questions.question: What is strategy hopping?
options: Changing trading strategies frequently after short-term results
Trading only during one market session
questions.explanation: Strategy hopping prevents traders from collecting enough data to properly evaluate a trading system.

questions.question: Before making major changes to a trading system, a trader should first:
options: Review sufficient trading data and evidence
questions.explanation: Professional traders make improvements based on evidence rather than emotions.

questions.question: Which of the following best describes continuous improvement?
options: Making small, evidence-based improvements over time
questions.explanation: Continuous improvement focuses on gradual, measurable progress rather than constant major changes.

questions.question: Which sequence best represents the professional trading improvement cycle taught in this course?
options: Plan → Trade → Journal → Review → Improve → Test → Repeat
questions.explanation: Professional traders continually plan, execute, record, review and improve their trading process.
